value.rationale: The precise probability that removal of any one sampled direction destroys origin inclusion is a natural robustness functional in random geometric feasibility. The solution gives a complete and nontrivial finite-sample law with a deterministic upper bound of two pivotal vertices, not just Wendel’s one-time probability; for n=5 only 1/11 of already-containing configurations are fully one-deletion robust.
